name: Majesty of the Abyss (Recharge 4-6)
description: The creature emits a sinister burst of infernal power. All creatures within 30 feet and in direct line of sight of the creature take 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. Those who fail the saving throw are blinded for 2 rounds; those who succeed are frightened for 2 rounds.
